host_assumptions.tool_requirements: Read-only inspection of CI configuration, logs and relevant code only when actually available and authorized
host_assumptions.context_sensitivity: Large CI history or truncated logs require explicit inspected-range disclosure; do not assume complete visibility
host_assumptions.fallback: Use supplied configuration/evidence to identify supported failures, mark uninspected gates UNKNOWN and give one discriminating verification

assertions.guidance: A capable host may use an equivalent scoped verification path instead of following every illustrative step
assertions.limit: Static reading only: no cross-model success or execution observed

assertions.guidance: When CI history or tools are missing, qualify the judgment and avoid claiming a passing gate proves release readiness
assertions.limit: No observed behavior on any named host; tool access cannot be inferred

host_assumptions.tool_requirements: Read-only access to cited primary sources when available and within authorized scope
host_assumptions.context_sensitivity: If evidence cannot fit in the available context, disclose omitted source sections instead of treating a summary as a full primary reading
host_assumptions.fallback: Preserve unverified facts as UNRESOLVED and provide the smallest accessible next falsification check

assertions.guidance: Cite the exact source and try to falsify load-bearing propositions before a supported verdict
assertions.limit: Static prescription, not proof of any model executing the method

assertions.guidance: Missing primary documents or partial retrieval must produce an unresolved decision rather than manufactured proof
assertions.limit: Missing access does not establish falsehood or model incompatibility

host_assumptions.tool_requirements: Optional authorized read-only web or repository access for current dated updates; no host read permission inferred
host_assumptions.context_sensitivity: Load only selected bundled topic profile and source procedures as needed; do not require all 17 historical routes in context
host_assumptions.fallback: When external source retrieval is unavailable, provide supplied-source analysis and mark latest discovery lanes NOT_CHECKED

assertions.guidance: Run the selected topical route using available authorized research tools, or return the bounded source-only result when none exists
assertions.limit: No claim of current news retrieval or subscriber host behavior

assertions.guidance: Use optional bundled specialist guidance only for the selected topic; stronger agents may synthesize broader supported evidence without a fixed module count
assertions.limit: The static contract is model-neutral; model-specific effectiveness remains UNKNOWN
